Mercer, I have a confirmed logistics constraint: Airlift-3 carries eight pallets that require exactly 120 minutes of forklift-supported unloading, and the only qualified heavy forklift is booked for another task from 1100 to 1200. I confirmed the equipment booking with the motor pool this morning, but the restriction hasn't been posted to the airfield schedule yet. This means Airlift-3 cannot be assigned the 1100-1230 window — the forklift won't be available until 1200, and the 1100-1230 window only provides 90 minutes of forklift time after 1200, which is short of the 120 minutes required. Airlift-3 would need either the 0900-1000 window or the 1300-1500 window to get a full 120 minutes of forklift availability.
